# PDF fixtures for Spec 16

These files are synthetic, project-owned documents generated by
`generate.py`. They are committed so the parser and OCR tests run from a
clean checkout without fonts, network access, or the ignored
`untracked-bond-research/` directory.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `text.pdf` | Two normal text-layer pages with dates, amounts and identifiers |
| `letter-spaced.pdf` | A text layer whose glyphs extract as single-character tokens |
| `image-only.pdf` | A rasterized term-sheet page with no text layer |
| `mixed.pdf` | Text page, scanned page, text page |
| `blank.pdf` | One genuinely blank page |
| `encrypted-empty-password.pdf` | Owner-password encrypted but readable with an empty user password |
| `encrypted-password.pdf` | Password-protected; must fail honestly |
| `non-latin.pdf` | Rasterized Cyrillic text; unsupported by the English gate |
| `malformed.pdf` | Truncated PDF structure |

Regenerate only when a fixture intentionally changes:

```powershell
cd backend
venv\Scripts\python.exe tests\fixtures\pdf\generate.py
```

The generated images use Arial when it is installed (Windows) and
DejaVu Sans otherwise. The committed bytes are authoritative.
